title: Common Errors
markdown:
## Compiler errors

| Message | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CS1002: ; expected` | A missing semicolon, often at the end of the line **before** | Add it | 1.01 |
| `CS0103: The name 'x' does not exist in the current context` | A typo, or a variable used outside the block that declares it | Check the spelling; declare it in the right scope | 1.05 |
| `CS0029: Cannot implicitly convert type 'string' to 'int'` | Assigning a value of the wrong type | Convert: `int.Parse(text)`, or fix the type | 1.02 |
| `CS0266: Cannot implicitly convert type 'double' to 'int'. An explicit conversion exists` | A conversion that may lose information | Cast `(int)x` or use `Math.Round` | 1.02 |
| `CS0165: Use of unassigned local variable 'x'` | Reading a local variable before every path assigns it | Initialise it when declared | 1.02 |
| `CS0019: Operator '&&' cannot be applied to operands of type 'int'` / `CS0029 ... to 'bool'` in `if (n)` | Conditions must be bool | `if (n != 0)` | 1.03 |
| `CS0161: not all code paths return a value` | A method can reach its end without `return` | Return on every path, or throw | 2.01 |
| `CS1501: No overload for method 'X' takes N arguments` | Wrong number of arguments | Check the method's parameters | 2.01 |
| `CS0136: A local named 'args' cannot be declared in this scope` | Reusing a name already used in an enclosing scope (`args` exists in top-level programs) | Choose another name | 2.01 |
| `CS0122: 'X' is inaccessible due to its protection level` | Using a `private` or `protected` member from outside | Make it public, or add a public method | 3.01 |
| `CS0200: Property 'X' cannot be assigned to -- it is read only` | Setting a get-only property | Set it in the constructor or initializer, or add `init`/`set` | 3.01 |
| `CS0534: 'C' does not implement inherited abstract member 'M'` | A derived class misses an abstract member | `override` it | 3.03 |
| `CS0535: 'C' does not implement interface member 'I.M'` | A class misses an interface member | Implement it (public, same signature) | 3.04 |
| `CS0506: cannot override inherited member because it is not marked virtual` | Overriding a non-virtual method | Mark the base method `virtual` (or `abstract`) | 3.03 |
| `CS0311` / `CS0315: The type 'X' cannot be used as type parameter 'T'` | A type argument breaks a `where` constraint | Use a type that fits, or relax the constraint | 4.01 |
| `CS4032: The 'await' operator can only be used within an async method` | `await` in a method without `async` | Mark it `async` and return `Task` | 5.01 |
| `CS8602: Dereference of a possibly null reference` (warning) | Using a `string?` or other nullable value without checking | Check for null, use `?.` / `??`, or fix the type | 2.05 |
| `CS0246: The type or namespace name 'X' could not be found` | A missing `using` or package reference | Add `using Namespace;` or the NuGet package | 3.05 |

## Exceptions at run time

| Exception | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NullReferenceException` | A member of `null` was used | Find which value was null; check before use, or make it non-nullable | 2.05 |
| `IndexOutOfRangeException` / `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` from a list | An index equal to `Length`/`Count` or negative | Indexes go from 0 to `Count - 1` | 2.02 |
| `KeyNotFoundException` | `dict[key]` for a missing key | `TryGetValue` or `GetValueOrDefault` | 2.03 |
| `FormatException` | `int.Parse` or `decimal.Parse` on text that is not a number | `TryParse`, and validate input | 1.02 |
| `InvalidOperationException: Collection was modified` | Adding or removing items while `foreach` loops over the collection | Loop over a copy, go backwards with `for`, or use `RemoveAll` | 2.02 |
| `InvalidOperationException: Sequence contains no elements` | `First()`, `Max()` or `Single()` on an empty sequence | `FirstOrDefault()`, or check `Any()` first | 2.04 |
| `DivideByZeroException` | Integer division by 0 | Check the divisor | 1.03 |
| `OverflowException` | A number too big for its type in `checked` code or `Parse` | Use `long` or `decimal`; validate input | 1.02 |
| `StackOverflowException` | Recursion without a base case, or a property that returns itself | Add the base case; use a backing field | 2.01 |
| `ObjectDisposedException` | Using a stream or other object after `Dispose` | Keep it alive while it is needed; check `using` scopes | 4.04 |
| `FileNotFoundException`, `IOException` | A missing or locked file | Check the path (`Path.Combine`), catch and report | 5.03 |
| `JsonException` | Invalid JSON or the wrong types for the target class | Check the JSON; validate data from outside | 5.04 |
| `TaskCanceledException` / `OperationCanceledException` | A token was cancelled or a timeout passed | Catch it where cancelling is expected | 5.02 |
| `HttpRequestException` | A network failure, or `EnsureSuccessStatusCode` on a 4xx/5xx response | Check `StatusCode`; retry only transient failures | 5.05 |

## Wrong results without an error

| Symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `7 / 2` gives 3 | Integer division | Make one side a double: `7 / 2.0` | 1.03 |
| `0.1 + 0.2` is not `0.3` | Binary floating point | Use `decimal` for money, or compare with a tolerance | 1.02 |
| `Math.Round(2.5)` gives 2 | Banker's rounding | `MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero` | 1.03 |
| Numbers print as `9,50` or parse wrongly | The computer's culture | Pass `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture` for files and data | 1.04 |
| Changing a copy changed the original | Classes, lists and arrays are references | Copy explicitly (`new List<T>(old)`, `with` on records) | 1.02 |
| A struct change "did not stick" | A copy of the struct was changed | Make structs immutable; reassign the whole value | 3.02 |
| Two equal-looking objects are not `==` | Classes compare references | Use a record, or override `Equals` | 3.02 |
| A query result changes or runs twice | Deferred execution | `ToList()` once and reuse the list | 2.04 |
| Argument checks in an iterator happen late | The iterator body runs only when enumerated | Check in a wrapper method that returns the iterator | 4.05 |
| The window freezes | Long work on the UI thread, or `.Result` / `.Wait()` | `await`, and `Task.Run` for CPU work | 5.01 |
| A file is empty or missing its end | The writer was not disposed (flushed) | `using` | 4.04 |
| A counter updated from several threads is too low | A race condition | `Interlocked`, `lock`, or no shared state | 5.02 |
